title: Motion House — Introduction
goal: Introduce our motion studio to a general public audience so they instantly feel what we do: turn plain ideas into beautiful, flowing motion — without any jargon.
audience: Anyone curious about our studio: founders, marketers, creators and first-time visitors with no technical background.
message: We turn your ideas into motion.
constraints: No technical jargon of any kind.
Only code-rendered type, shapes and paths.
One continuous idea that keeps evolving — never a slideshow.
assumptions: The public does not need to know how the motion is made.
A calm, elegant register suits a first impression.
